description:
Dying as an overworked convenience store clerk, Ava wakes up as Elara—a useless princess forced into a deadly sacrificial marriage to the feared Dragon King Caedran!

When she exposes a lethal trap on her wedding day, she plunges straight into a dangerous struggle between the cold Dragon King, a protective dragon hybrid guard, and a prince with a shared past.

✨ Key Highlights:
• Transmigration & Instant Revenge
• Dangerous Dragon Court Intrigue & Romance
• One Bride vs. Three Fierce Dragons
